revisions_tested: unknown: not run on a board yet

ble.advertising: connectable; flags and the 128-bit service UUID in the advertising data, name in the scan response

colour.format: 3 bytes R,G,B; a channel is on at 128 or more

pattern.format: up to 16 steps of R,G,B (3 bytes) + duration ms (uint16 little endian); empty = solid colour

status.format: ASCII, e.g. 'up=12s step=2/4' or 'up=12s solid', notified once a second

ble.security: open: no pairing or bonding is requested or required
ble.leds: red and green user LEDs of the kit (blue has no LED and is ignored)

elf.note: stripped; the .hex was made from the unstripped ELF

config.origin: read from the LP-EM-CC2755P10 on probe LB07021W on 2026-10-15 (web flasher save); the build's own CCFG and SCFG match them except the CCFG user record (0x750 to 0x7CF) and the CRC fields, which the image takes from these files

expect: advertises as FRL Light; a Web Bluetooth page can connect without a PIN, set the LED colour, play a pattern and read the status
release_note: Built from TI's basic_ble example (BSD-3-Clause, NOTICE.txt) plus our frl_light.c. Not cleared for public distribution; not yet run on a board.
